rules.rule: Check for urgent routine antenatal care conditions
rules.problem: Covers every red-box item. Minor: 'persistent' qualifier on headache not expressible; no gestational-age item although the page's logic depends on < 37, < 22, 26-33 weeks.

rules.rule: Check for miscarriage signs in pregnant patient with vaginal bleeding
rules.problem: Faithful to the cervical-os question, but the page asks it only in early pregnancy < 22 weeks (late pregnancy: avoid digital vaginal examination). Triggering it for all vaginal bleeding contradicts the late-pregnancy branch.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable severe pre-eclampsia in antenatal patient
rules.problem: Structure matches both red-box lines; 'persistent' and '>= 1+' proteinuria qualifiers are lost (imprecise, low-medium).

rules.rule: Diagnose probable preterm labour in antenatal patient
rules.problem: Missing the '< 37 weeks' condition: any painful contractions in pregnancy (including normal term labour) produce probable preterm labour, which then makes the patient Urgent via active_condition.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable prelabour rupture of membranes in antenatal patient
Diagnose possible threatened miscarriage in antenatal patient
rules.problem: Page says 'likely' (-> probable by house rule) and only in early pregnancy < 22 weeks; rule is possible and has no gestation limit, so a late-pregnancy bleed with no os findings recorded yields possible threatened miscarriage.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible complete miscarriage in antenatal patient
rules.problem: Same as threatened miscarriage: certainty downgraded from 'likely' and no < 22 weeks constraint.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible ectopic pregnancy in antenatal patient with vaginal bleeding
rules.problem: 'Refer to exclude ectopic pregnancy' -> possible is correct, but without the < 22 weeks constraint it fires in late pregnancy too.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible incomplete miscarriage in antenatal patient
rules.problem: Page says 'likely'; encoded possible; no early-pregnancy constraint.

rules.rule: Diagnose possible inevitable miscarriage in antenatal patient
rules.problem: Page says 'likely'; encoded possible; no early-pregnancy constraint.

rules.rule: Urgent: pregnant patient with antenatal danger signs
rules.problem: Urgent matches 'Give urgent attention'; all 12 red-box items present with correct and/or (swollen AND painful calf; temp AND severe back/abdominal pain; BP >= 160/110 without proteinuria). Inherits the preterm-labour over-firing via active_condition. No diagnosis rule for 'treat as severe hypertension' (no exact SNOMED concept), which is handled inline here.

summary: Most consequential: the probable preterm labour rule drops the page's '< 37 weeks' condition, so any painful contractions (including term labour) give probable preterm labour and, via active_condition, an Urgent priority. The five miscarriage/ectopic rules have no early-pregnancy (< 22 weeks) limit, and the four miscarriage types the page calls 'likely' are encoded as possible. Smaller losses: 'persistent' headache and the '>= 1+' proteinuria threshold.
